subscriptions.the_shop_keeps_what_it_paid: The shop keeps what it paid for until the cycle ends, then moves to the cheaper plan. No refund is due.
subscriptions.the_cheaper_plan_starts_now_no: The cheaper plan starts now. No refund or credit is given for the unused days.
subscriptions.0_means_no_trial_common_choices: 0 means no trial. Common choices: 7 or 14.
subscriptions.discontinued_plans_cannot_be_given_to: discontinued plans cannot be given to new shops but keep their history
subscriptions.read_only_old_orders_can_be: Read-only: old orders can be viewed but no new print requests are accepted. Customers see the shop as unavailable.
subscriptions.the_shop_portal_is_locked_except_2: The shop portal is locked except Billing. Customers see “This shop is temporarily unavailable”.
subscriptions.automatic_messages_are_sent_before_renew: Automatic messages are sent: before renewal, when a payment fails, halfway through the extra days to pay, and a final warning before suspension.
subscriptions.only_for_shops_paying_through_a: Only for shops paying through a connected online payment service. Shops that pay offline are followed up with reminders instead.
subscriptions.no_online_payment_service_is_connected: No online payment service is connected yet, so these rules take effect once one is added.
subscriptions.used_for_every_shop_unless_that: Used for every shop unless that shop picks its own on its billing page.
subscriptions.in_app_messages_are_delivered_now: In-app messages are delivered now. Email, SMS and WhatsApp messages are queued and recorded, but no provider is connected yet, so nothing is sent on those channels.
subscriptions.checks_also_run_automatically_every_15: Checks also run automatically every 15 minutes.

subscriptions.full_access_with_a_warning_banner: Full access with a warning banner ({{daysLeft}} extra day(s) to pay left). Customers can still order.
subscriptions.read_only_the_shop_can_view: Read-only: the shop can view old orders but cannot accept new print requests. Customers see the shop as unavailable.
subscriptions.locked_only_the_billing_page_is: Locked: only the Billing page is available to the shop. Customers see “This shop is temporarily unavailable”.
subscriptions.pick_a_different_plan_or_billing: Pick a different plan or billing period.
subscriptions.the_new_plan_starts_immediately_and: The new plan starts immediately and the trial continues. Nothing is charged yet.

subscriptions.upgrade_starts_at_the_next_renewal: Upgrade: starts at the next renewal
subscriptions.the_shop_stays_on_until_choose: The shop stays on {{name}} until {{short}}. Choose “Apply now” to charge the difference for the days left straight away.
subscriptions.downgrade_at_the_end_of_the: Downgrade: at the end of the billing period
subscriptions.the_shop_keeps_until_then_moves: The shop keeps {{name}} until {{short}}, then moves to {{name2}}. No refund is due.
subscriptions.the_cheaper_plan_starts_immediately_with: The cheaper plan starts immediately, with no credit for unused days.
subscriptions.the_plan_switches_immediately_at_no: The plan switches immediately at no charge.
subscriptions.enter_a_number_of_days_between: Enter a number of days between 1 and 366.
subscriptions.payment_recorded_but_the_shop_is: Payment recorded, but the shop is still paused by an admin
subscriptions.return_it_to_automatic_rules_to: Return it to automatic rules to turn it back on.
subscriptions.monthly_price_can_t_be_more: Monthly price can’t be more than 30 days of the daily price.
subscriptions.yearly_price_can_t_be_more: Yearly price can’t be more than 12 months of the monthly price.
subscriptions.this_can_t_be_undone_a: This can’t be undone. A plan that shops or invoices still use can only be discontinued, not deleted.
subscriptions.use_whole_numbers_the_retry_interval: Use whole numbers; the retry interval must be at least 1 day.
subscriptions.grace_rule: The shop keeps full access and sees a warning banner.
subscriptions.manual_payments_note: No online payment service (Razorpay, Stripe, …) is connected. Payments are recorded by an admin with Mark paid (cash, UPI, bank transfer). Automatic renewals and retries switch on once one is added.
subscriptions.extend_by_days_help: The renewal date moves later by this many days.
subscriptions.extra_days_to_pay_help: The shop keeps full access for this long. A shop with an overdue payment gets full access back during these days.
